question.text: A compound formed by elements $X$ and $Y$ crystallises in the cubic structure, where $X$ atoms are at the corners of a cube and $Y$ atoms are at the centre of the body. The formula of the compounds is

solution.text: Number of $X$ atoms at the corners $=8$ Number of $X$ atoms per unit cell $=8 \times \frac{1}{8}=1$ atom Number of $Y$ atoms at the centre of the body $=1$ atom Hence, the formula of the compound is $X Y$.
